baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction qaddamtu li-hayati joins a completed forward act to life as its directed beneficiary or destination.
baseline_models.mechanism: The q-d-m inventory combines a deed or merit already gone ahead, forward precedence, and deliberate orientation. The h-y-y inventory permits life to be saving benefit rather than bare duration. The counterfactual therefore concerns value that should have been made to precede its maker.

activation_trace.role: Prior merit or deed supplies the concrete provision that can precede a person.
Forward advance supplies a directional movement, not merely earlier chronology.
Life as benefit or saving good specifies what the forwarded provision was meant to realize.

changed_reading.before: I wish I had done something earlier for my future.
changed_reading.after: I wish I had caused beneficial deed and precedent to arrive ahead of me, directed toward the life that such good sustains.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Present yaqûlu encloses the counterfactual past qaddamtu, so actual speech now stands beside absent action then.
baseline_models.mechanism: The q-w-l branches keep both audible utterance and an inner saying in play. The wish moves the inward counterfactual into speech, but speech cannot perform the missing forward act. The verse therefore stages a substitution failure: articulation becomes exact only after action is unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance is the speaker's only realized action in the line.
An inward saying supplies the counterfactual pressure that is finally externalized.
Forward action furnishes the missing counterpart against which present speech is exposed as late.

changed_reading.after: The utterance is itself evidence of belatedness: an inner counterfactual becomes perfectly sayable only when saying can no longer replace advancing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lamed relation in li-hayati allows life to receive the benefit and direction of qaddamtu.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate turning in q-d-m combines with h-y-y branches of preserving life and producing saving good. This keeps open a reading in which life is not only a later account owned by the speaker; it is the good that prior agency should have protected or generated.

activation_trace.role: Intentional turning toward a thing makes life the aim of agency rather than a passive time span.
Sparing and preserving alive supplies a concrete life-protecting function.
Saving benefit broadens life into a produced good that can receive action.

changed_reading.before: The speaker wishes he had stored private credit for a later existence.
changed_reading.after: The speaker wishes his prior agency had been intentionally turned toward preserving and producing life-giving good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Threshold, darkness, pairing, singleness, and nocturnal travel form a clock made of transitions. Against that moving sequence, qaddamtu becomes action that should have kept pace with passing opportunities. The final wish is late not only by date but by failure to move while time itself moved.

activation_trace.role: Forward precedence anchors the changed reading in the focus act.
Daybreak emerging from night supplies a threshold at which hidden time becomes visible.
Night as darkness supplies the repeated temporal field through which opportunities pass.
Joining one thing to its like supplies paired units in an ordered sequence.
A single unpaired unit prevents the sequence from collapsing into undifferentiated repetition.
Travel by night turns the temporal field into an active passage that leaves the stationary behind.

structural_cues: 89:1-5 form an oath sequence of threshold, counted nights, pair and single, and a night in motion.
Night recurs at 89:2 and 89:4, changing counted duration into visible passage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered transitions and a traveling night; I infer that their passage measures the lost window for qaddamtu. A live alternative is that the oath sequence authorizes the warning without mapping stages of a life.

changed_reading.before: The speaker regrets an unspecified past omission.
changed_reading.after: The speaker regrets remaining ethically stationary while a finely divided life kept crossing thresholds and carrying its chances away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cut rock and fixed structures look like achievements sent into the future, yet the sequence routes unmatched material power through exceeded limits and damaged order to vigilant consequence. Qaddamtu is therefore revised from any durable accomplishment to a morally viable precedent. What goes ahead can become evidence against its maker.

activation_trace.role: Prior deed or standing anchors the question of which accomplishments truly count as provision.
Saving benefit supplies the criterion that distinguishes life-giving precedent from impressive damage.
Penetrating cutting supplies forceful transformation of resistant material.
Massive hard stone makes the achievement materially durable and publicly legible.
Peg-like fixity supplies the claim of stability that the later sequence overturns.
Exceeding a limit converts material advance into moral overrun.
Departure from sound order names the functional product of the celebrated power.
Vigilant watching makes consequence outlast the builders' confidence in permanence.

structural_cues: 89:6-14 moves from unmatched construction and cut stone to transgression, multiplied corruption, poured punishment, and watch.
The branchless ك ي ف at 89:6 is used only as an interrogative demand to inspect that process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies durable works followed by moral overrun and watched consequence; I infer that durability without saving benefit sends an indictment ahead. Alternatively, the ruins may function only as warning examples rather than as a direct contrast with qaddamtu.

changed_reading.before: The wish is for more or larger achievements left behind.
changed_reading.after: The wish is for a precedent that remains beneficial under judgment; monuments can survive as the wrong kind of thing sent ahead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated yaqûlu first voices a doctrine that abundance proves honor and constriction proves humiliation. Trial branches instead make changing conditions reveal the subject, while the rejection at 89:17 relocates worth into response. The focus saying is thus a final correction of the speaker's earlier grammar of value, not merely a new emotional outburst.

activation_trace.role: The focus utterance anchors the third and corrective saying in the repeated speech pattern.
Testing that makes a condition visible turns ease into evidence about response, not proof of rank.
Saying as held doctrine marks the first evaluation as an interpretive system, not neutral report.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the condition that the speaker mislabels as humiliation.
Saying with the force of supposing exposes inference inside the second verdict.
Humiliation through being made light supplies the false moral label attached to restricted provision.
Honorable generosity relocates karama from what one receives to what one extends.

structural_cues: Yaqûlu recurs at 89:15, 89:16, and 89:24 with first-person evaluations.
The rejection and pivot at 89:17 overturn the two resource-based verdicts before the final saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence, testing, opposed allocations, and explicit rejection; I infer that the last saying corrects the same value-making habit. A live alternative is that 89:24 voices a generic human type rather than the identical individual of both earlier cases.

changed_reading.before: A condemned person regrets having accumulated too little merit.
changed_reading.after: The speaker finally retracts a life-long misreading: received abundance or restriction never settled worth; the response to each condition was what had to be sent ahead.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inheritance arrives from a prior holder, but the recipient consumes and gathers it rather than forwarding honor and food toward people cut off from support. This creates a blocked relay. Qaddamtu li-hayati becomes the missed conversion of received wealth into another's sustaining life, which would also have become the giver's prior provision.

activation_trace.role: A deed sent ahead anchors the outgoing side of the proposed social relay.
Saving benefit makes another person's sustained good a valid realization of life.
Honorable generosity supplies the outward treatment that replaces self-measured honor.
Severance from a caretaker identifies where the relay of support has already broken.
Urging toward an act makes provision a mutually activated social practice, not isolated charity.
Feeding another supplies the concrete outward transfer.
Sustenance that stabilizes residence explains feeding as preservation of a person's viable place.
Consuming and taking wealth reverses the direction from outward provision to inward depletion.
Transfer from predecessor to heir marks wealth as something already received through a temporal relay.
Gathering scattered things into one mass supplies the hoarding operation that stops circulation.
Acquiring and increasing property names the object around which the relay is arrested.
Accumulation to fullness supplies the endpoint of inward massing instead of outward advancement.

structural_cues: The omissions of 89:17-18 are followed by active consumption and accumulation in 89:19-20.
Cognate-object intensification around eating and love, capped by jamman, makes blocked circulation habitual and totalizing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inheritance, ingestion, massing, severed care, urging, and feeding; I infer a relay in which received goods should be advanced into sustaining others and thereby become prior merit. Alternatively, the listed failures may remain parallel offenses without a single circulation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: I wish I had banked more good for my own life.
changed_reading.after: I wish I had kept provision moving: what reached me should have gone forward as honor, food, and stability for vulnerable life, becoming my provision precisely through that transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ground is leveled, ordered ranks appear, one arrival occurs, another thing is brought into presence, and memory is recovered. This is a directional inversion around qaddamtu: everything that discloses the reckoning comes forward, while the speaker's saving provision did not. His saying names the asymmetry one beat too late.

activation_trace.role: Forward advance anchors the absent movement against the context's many arrivals.
The utterance is the final arrival in the sequence, but it carries no substitute provision.
Repeated demolition to levelness removes the terrain on which prior status seemed stable.
Coming into presence initiates the context's explicit arrival pattern.
Alignment on straight ranks replaces amassed private order with exposed public order.
Bringing a thing and making it present sharpens the contrast with provision never brought forward.
Recovery after forgetting supplies cognition that arrives only after the material disclosure.
Reaching the appointed maturity or time marks why recovered memory no longer produces advance.

structural_cues: The doubled forms at 89:21 and 89:22 create total leveling followed by total alignment.
The repeated day-marker at 89:23 places remembering immediately before the focus utterance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies leveling, arrivals, compelled presentation, and recovered memory; I infer that these movements expose the missing counter-movement of beneficial deeds. Alternatively, qaddamtu may remain purely temporal and need not answer the spatial arrival pattern.

changed_reading.before: The speaker remembers too late that he should have acted.
changed_reading.after: A whole order arrives and is brought forward, but nothing life-giving arrives from him; remembrance and speech now make that directional vacancy visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bold or intentional advance in the focus is followed by punishment and uniquely forceful binding. This permits an agency reversal: while movement was available, desire and possession were left ungoverned; afterward the subject is governed from outside. The wished-for advance becomes voluntary commitment to life-giving action before involuntary restraint.

activation_trace.role: Bold forward undertaking supplies the voluntary agency later contrasted with restraint.
Deliberate orientation supplies the self-directed commitment that was possible before compulsion.
Restraint or weaning supplies a latent checking function beneath the explicit punitive setting.
Painful punishment keeps the reversal grounded in imposed consequence rather than self-help.
Exhaustive negation makes the agency of punishment incomparable and closes ordinary alternatives.
Fastening with a bond supplies the final externally imposed limit on movement.
Repeated exhaustive negation seals the paired punishment and binding construction.

structural_cues: 89:25-26 pair a derived verb with its cognate noun and close both clauses with ahad.
The pair follows the focus wish immediately, allowing a sharp available-agency versus imposed-restraint reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bold advance, punishment, restraint, and binding; I infer that missed voluntary discipline precedes involuntary confinement. A live alternative is that the pair states consequence only, with no implied symmetry to self-binding.

changed_reading.before: The speaker wishes for extra merit that might reduce punishment.
changed_reading.after: The speaker wishes he had committed his mobile agency to life-giving action before unchecked appetite ended in agency imposed from outside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence addresses a life-bearing self, marks settledness, commands return, names reciprocal acceptance, and then doubles entry into a people and a protected garden. This activates li-hayati as relational life rather than solitary survival. The provision sent ahead would be whatever makes return, belonging, and entry coherent.

activation_trace.role: Intentional orientation anchors the wished-for movement toward a relational destination.
Saving good lets life include the condition of accepted return and belonging.
The self by which life subsists supplies the addressed bearer of the alternate outcome.
Settled composure supplies an inward state opposite the focus speaker's counterfactual agitation.
Return to a prior relation supplies movement whose destination is not mere continued existence.
Reciprocal acceptance makes the returned life mutually relational rather than privately possessed.
Crossing into an interior supplies the first admission, here into a human collective.
Obedient service identifies the collective into which the self is admitted.
The repeated crossing supplies a second, nested admission rather than one undifferentiated destination.
A garden enclosed by growth supplies protected, living interiority as the final place of entry.

structural_cues: A feminine singular vocative is followed by return, reciprocal-state predicates, and two successive imperatives of entry.
Entry into servants precedes entry into the garden, preserving social belonging as a distinct stage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a settled self, return, reciprocal acceptance, collective belonging, and protected entry; I infer that these specify a relational sense of the life named in the focus. Alternatively, the closing address may contrast a different addressee and outcome without defining the focus speaker's li-hayati.

changed_reading.before: My life is a private future duration for which I should have saved.
changed_reading.after: The desired life is a returned and accepted relation, entered through belonging; prior action would have oriented the self toward that shared interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the focus q-w-l occurrence and cannot license a lexical replacement for yaqûlu. It remains anchored because lifting and rising converge with the focus foot and advance inventory. Downstream prose should render it only as a latent pressure-image: speech attempts to lift what action failed to carry.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places yaqûlu directly before a wished-for qaddamtu, allowing the utterance to inherit a contained load-and-movement image.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant split supplies carrying, lifting, and rising as a latent material pressure within the utterance.
The stepping foot gives the attempted lift a focus-internal movement anchor.

changed_reading.before: He voices regret about an unperformed deed.
changed_reading.after: At a latent material level, the utterance is an attempted lift: speech rises only after the burden that deed should have carried has been left behind.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is branch-distant because the tool sense under q-d-m is not the lexical sense of qaddamtu. It remains visibly anchored in the focus inventory and gains a coherent material sequence from cut stone to total leveling. Downstream prose should qualify it as an imagistic analogy, not a translation or historical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus q-d-m inventory contains a carving tool image, while qaddamtu still supplies the failed act that should have shaped what endured.

activation_trace.role: The carving tool supplies a form-distant image of deliberate shaping inside the focus root.
Penetrating stone-cutting externalizes shaping as monumental material work.
Hard massive rock supplies the apparently durable surface on which that work is imposed.
Pulverizing demolition to levelness removes the supposedly durable record and tests what shaping survives.

changed_reading.before: The speaker failed to send enough discrete deeds ahead.
changed_reading.after: The speaker failed to shape a life whose moral form could survive the leveling that erases even expertly carved permanence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it links the focus inventory's rain-revived earth to social feeding, accumulated wealth, and the context's punitive pouring. It remains anchored in hayati and the forward direction of qaddamtu, but the nourishing-versus-punitive flow arrow is reader-supplied. Downstream prose should present it as an ecological analogy, not as a claim that the punishment image literally means rain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Hayati activates earth made alive by water, while qaddamtu can orient a flow toward the life it should benefit.

activation_trace.role: Earth revived through rain and growth supplies the focus-anchored ecology of life receiving a flow.
Forward movement gives that potential nourishment a direction from holder toward beneficiary.
Pouring supplies the context's opposite flow, one that arrives as consequence rather than nourishment.
Feeding another translates life-giving flow into a concrete social channel.
Taking and consuming wealth reverses nourishment inward and interrupts its outward channel.
Increasing property supplies the reservoir that remains amassed instead of irrigating vulnerable life.

changed_reading.before: Life is a destination into which merit is deposited.
changed_reading.after: Life is also a field made fertile by forward circulation: held wealth could have become nourishment, but the blocked flow is answered by a different kind of pouring.

strongest_changes: Repeated yaqûlu turns the focus speech into a correction of earlier wealth-based verdicts.
Qaddamtu becomes a social relay: inherited or possessed provision should have moved forward into vulnerable life rather than inward into consumption and massing.
The leveling, arrival, presentation, and remembering sequence creates a directional vacancy in which everything comes forward except the speaker's saving provision.
The closing return and doubled entry preserve a coexisting reading of life as accepted relation and belonging, not private duration alone.
summary.what_was_special: The three focus roots remained mobile across the packet: speech shifted from doctrine to confession, advance from chronology to precedent and circulation, and life from duration to preserved social good and relational return. Non-dominant, tool, and water activations were retained with explicit containment rather than silently removed.
remaining_uncertainties: The lamed relation in li-hayati can still favor beneficiary, purpose, destination, or some overlap among them.
The settled self in 89:27-30 may define the positive counterpart to the focus speaker or may be a deliberately separate addressee.
The non-dominant split, carving-tool, binding, and irrigation readings carry imagistic force but should not be promoted into lexical translations.
